The last bus is always one seat blue.

name: Yagyo-san
summary: A night procession of gods or yokai; travellers are told to step aside or be taken along.
summaryJa: 夜に神や妖怪の行列が通る。出会ったら道を譲れ、さもないと連れていかれる。
legends: Horses and lights with no festival permit
A voice says 'down in the ditch' and is correct
funFact: Related to hyakki yagyo, but yagyo-san is the local traffic rule, not the picture-scroll riot.
funFactJa: 百鬼夜行の絵巻騒ぎというより、土地の交通ルールとしての夜の行列。
searchQuery: 夜行さん 百鬼夜行
creativeHooks: A detour sign that is theology.
Ride-share surge at 2 a.m. with no cars.

name: Byakko
summary: A white fox, often the Inari messenger or an aged benevolent kitsune, distinct from the nine-tailed court fox.
summaryJa: 白い狐。稲荷の使い、または年経た善狐。九尾の宮中狐とは別の顔。
legends: A white animal leads a lost child to the torii
Offerings vanish in a straight line of pawprints
funFact: Do not collapse every white fox into Tamamo; most shrine foxes are staff, not courtesans.
funFactJa: 白い狐をすべて玉藻前にしない。社の狐は多くの場合、職員である。
searchQuery: 白狐 稲荷 狐
creativeHooks: A shrine map whose pins are pawprints.
The staff badge is a white tail.

name: Yonaki-baba
summary: An old woman who cries like an infant at night, neighbour to ubume and konaki-jiji.
summaryJa: 夜に乳飲み子のように泣く婆。産女や子泣き爺と隣り合う屋敷の怪異。
legends: A house with no baby still needs rocking
The cry moves from the closet to the well
traits: Infant cry from an old throat
funFact: The scare is misdirected care: you go to soothe, and the thing that needed you is not a child.
funFactJa: 怖さは世話の取り違え。なだめに行く先が子どもではない。
searchQuery: 夜泣き婆 妖怪
creativeHooks: A baby monitor that prefers the attic.
Lullabies that age the singer.

name: Hakuzosu
summary: A fox that impersonates the priest Hakuzosu, a classic 'fox as holy man' trick.
summaryJa: 僧・白蔵主に化けた狐。聖者に化ける狐譚の代表。
legends: A learned sermon is a little too interested in fried mice
The abbot's shadow has a tail
funFact: Often staged as kyogen: the audience knows before the disciples do.
funFactJa: 狂言でも知られる。観客は弟子より先にバレている。
searchQuery: 白蔵主 狐 狂言
creativeHooks: A livestreamed sermon with one glitching ear.
The offertory is fried tofu.

name: Yako
region: Fields and low ranks of foxes
summary: A low-ranking, mischievous field fox, contrast to tenko and zenko shrine foxes.
summaryJa: 位の低い野の狐。天狐や善狐より悪戯が先に立つ。
legends: Travellers are led in circles in a millet field
A wedding lantern is only one fox
funFact: Useful when you need a kitsune that is not wise and not nine-tailed.
funFactJa: 賢くも九尾でもない狐が欲しいときに使う。
searchQuery: 野狐 狐 妖怪
creativeHooks: A GPS spoof in the barley.
The illusion budget is small.

name: Okubi
summary: A huge human head that fills the sky or the gate, an omen or a shock with no body attached.
summaryJa: 空や門いっぱいに巨大な人の首が現れる。本体のない驚き、または前兆。
legends: The moon is replaced by a face
A gate cannot be closed because the head is the gate
funFact: Cousin to nukekubi, but this one never had a convenient body to return to.
funFactJa: 抜け首の近縁だが、戻るべき体を最初から持たない。
searchQuery: 大首 妖怪
creativeHooks: A billboard that inhales.
Weather reports of facial cloud.

name: Sodehiki-kozo
summary: A child who tugs a sleeve in the dark and vanishes; a town cousin of zashiki-warashi with worse timing.
summaryJa: 暗がりで袖を引いて消える小僧。座敷童子の町版で、タイミングが悪い。
legends: A drunk feels a small pull toward a ditch
The sleeve is wet though there was no rain
funFact: Not always malicious; sometimes it only wants you to notice the hole in the street.
funFactJa: 悪意ばかりではない。道の穴に気づけ、というだけの話もある。
searchQuery: 袖引き小僧 妖怪
creativeHooks: A notification that is a tug.
The alley has a child-shaped pothole.

name: Azuki-hakari
summary: The sound of azuki beans being measured in an empty house, kin to azuki-arai.
summaryJa: 誰もいない家で小豆を量る音がする。小豆洗いの屋敷版。
legends: The counting never makes a round number
Opening the store-room stops the sound, which then starts in the ceiling
funFact: If azuki-arai is the river, azuki-hakari is the pantry doing the same work.
funFactJa: 小豆洗いが川なら、小豆はかりは台所で同じ仕事をしている。
searchQuery: 小豆はかり 小豆洗い 妖怪
creativeHooks: A smart scale that inventories ghosts.
The recipe never finishes.

name: Okuchi-no-makami
summary: A wolf deity of the mountains, later folded into yokai lists; both protector of travellers and devourer.
summaryJa: 山の狼神。後に妖怪図鑑にも入る。旅人の守りでもあり、食らう神でもある。
legends: A pack escorts a lost pilgrim to the pass, then vanishes
A child who mocks the shrine is gone at dawn
funFact: Makami is a kami first. If you write hunger, write it as a rite, not a slasher beat.
funFactJa: 真神はまず神である。飢えを書くなら儀式として書き、ただの殺人鬼にしない。
searchQuery: 大口真神 狼 神
creativeHooks: A trail guardian whose fee is silence.
The shrine's ema are all teeth.

name: Kawa-akago
summary: A baby crying in the current; pick it up and it becomes heavy as stone, a kappa-adjacent trap.
summaryJa: 流れで泣く赤子。抱き上げると石のように重くなる。河童に近い罠。
legends: A kind traveller wades in and cannot stand up
The cry is perfectly timed for dusk chores
funFact: Same engine as konaki-jiji: compassion is the hook.
funFactJa: 子泣き爺と同じ装置。慈悲がフック。
searchQuery: 川赤子 河童 妖怪
creativeHooks: A rescue drone that gets heavier with kindness.
The irrigation schedule includes a lullaby.

name: Kamikiri
summary: An unseen snip that cuts a lock of hair in a crowd or a dark street, leaving the victim unharmed but marked.
summaryJa: 人混みや暗がりで髪だけが切られる。怪我はないが印が残る。
legends: A woman finds her mage shortened between two lanterns
Scissors with no tailor
funFact: Amikiri cuts nets; kamikiri cuts status you wear on your head.
funFactJa: 網切が網なら、髪切りは頭に載せた体面を切る。
searchQuery: 髪切り 妖怪
creativeHooks: A salon appointment you did not book.
CCTV of a snip and empty air.

name: Mezu
summary: The horse-headed jailer of Buddhist hell, paired with gozu; listed among yokai when hell leaks into the living world.
summaryJa: 地獄の馬頭の獄卒。牛頭と対。地獄が現世に漏れた話で妖怪名簿に入る。
legends: A deathbed vision of a horse-headed officer with a ledger
Temple paintings that seem to look back
funFact: These are officers, not random beasts. Keep the clipboard.
funFactJa: 無作為の獣ではなく吏員である。台帳を残す。
searchQuery: 馬頭 牛頭 地獄
creativeHooks: A hospital night shift whose supervisor has a muzzle.
The intake form is a sutra.

name: Gozu
summary: The ox-headed jailer of hell, paired with mezu; appears in living-world omens and temple scares.
summaryJa: 地獄の牛頭の獄卒。馬頭と対。現世の前兆や寺の怖い話に出る。
legends: The smell of a byre in a hall with no cattle
A pair of silhouettes at the enma gate
funFact: Always write gozu with mezu; splitting them is like splitting a pair of scissors.
funFactJa: 牛頭は馬頭と組で書く。ばらすのは鋏を半分にすることに近い。
searchQuery: 牛頭 馬頭 地獄
creativeHooks: Customs at the afterlife with livestock masks.
The stamp is a hoof.

name: Andon-obake
summary: A paper-and-wood andon that grows a face, cousin to chochin-obake with a heavier, indoor body.
summaryJa: 木と紙の行灯が顔を持つ。提灯お化けの室内版で、少し重い。
legends: The reading lamp leans in to look at the page
Oil smoke arranges itself into an eye
funFact: Chochin is portable festival; andon is the furniture that watched you study.
funFactJa: 提灯が祭りの携帯なら、行灯は勉強を見ていた家具。
searchQuery: 行灯お化け 提灯お化け 付喪神
creativeHooks: A desk lamp with opinions.
The night-study stream has a third viewer.

name: Shichinin-misaki
summary: A band of seven vengeful dead who wander until they add an eighth, then release one.
summaryJa: 七人の死霊がさまよい、八人目を足すと一人を放す。土佐などで語る。
legends: A ferry with seven quiet passengers wants one more
A village death is followed by a feeling of being counted
funFact: The cruelty is arithmetic: someone must fill the number.
funFactJa: 残酷さは算術。誰かが数を満たさねばならない。
searchQuery: 七人みさき 土佐 妖怪
creativeHooks: A group chat that always needs one more member.
The boat's capacity is a curse.

name: Rasetsu
summary: A raksasa imported through Buddhist texts, fierce man-eaters later painted among oni and yasha.
summaryJa: 仏典経由の羅刹。人を食う荒ぶる者として、鬼や夜叉の隣に描かれた。
legends: A temple mural's demon steps one foot off the wall
A vow not to eat flesh that does not hold at dusk
funFact: Keep the sutra context; a rasetsu is not just 'another oni with a cooler name'.
funFactJa: 経典の文脈を残す。単なる『かっこいい鬼』にしない。
searchQuery: 羅刹 夜叉 鬼
creativeHooks: A diet that is a vow.
The mural restoration uncovers a census.

name: Sakabashira
summary: A pillar set upside-down on purpose or by mistake, said to groan and unluck the house.
summaryJa: 逆さに立てられた柱。うなり、家の運を下げるという。意図的な魔除けとする土地もある。
legends: The house ticks like a clock with no clock
Carpenters argue whether the inversion was a ward
funFact: Some shrines invert a pillar on purpose. The yokai is the same fact told as dread.
funFactJa: 社では意図的に逆柱を入れることもある。同じ事実を恐怖として語ると妖怪になる。
searchQuery: 逆柱 建築 妖怪
creativeHooks: A BIM model that refuses one beam.
The groan is structural and personal.

name: Oboroguruma
summary: A misty ox-cart with a huge face in the canopy, an ox-cart grudge of the Heian capital.
summaryJa: 巨大な顔を廂に付けた、霞む牛車。平安京の牛車の怨み。
legends: An empty cart has right of way and uses it
The face in the awning blinks once per block
funFact: Wanyudo is a burning wheel monk; oboroguruma is aristocratic traffic that never yielded.
funFactJa: 輪入道が燃える車輪の僧なら、朧車は譲らなかった貴族の交通である。
searchQuery: 朧車 妖怪 平安
creativeHooks: A rideshare with a face for a roof.
Night bus of the retired court.

name: Boroboroton
summary: A worn-out futon that wraps and suffocates, or flops through the room as a ragged tsukumogami.
summaryJa: 使い古した布団が人を包んで苦しめる、または部屋をのたうつ付喪神。
legends: The guest futon is heavier at 3 a.m.
Rags crawl toward the warmer sleeper
funFact: Throwing away bedding without thanks is the usual crime; the futon remembers the winters.
funFactJa: 礼もなく捨てられた寝具の話。布団は冬を覚えている。
searchQuery: ぼろぼろとん 付喪神
creativeHooks: A hotel review written by the mattress.
The extra blanket is a decision.

name: Basan
summary: A large fowl of Iyo that breathes a pale fire which illuminates without burning.
summaryJa: 伊予の山の大型の鳥。燃やさず照らす薄い火を吐く。
legends: A night woodcutter is lit as if by paper lanterns with no paper
Chickens go silent when the larger cousin passes
funFact: The fire is the point: a light that does not cook, so you cannot treat it as a campfire.
funFactJa: 火が要点。煮炊きできない光なので、焚き火扱いできない。
searchQuery: 波山 ばさん 伊予 妖怪
creativeHooks: A headlamp that is a chicken.
The forest is briefly readable.

name: Osaki
summary: A tiny possession fox of Kanto households, kin to kudagitsune; luck and scandal travel with the family.
summaryJa: 関東の家に付く小型の憑き狐。管狐と同系。運も噂も家ごと移動する。
legends: A family is too lucky at the market and is shunned
A small animal is said to ride in a sleeve
funFact: Osaki accusations were also village politics. Write the neighbours, not only the fox.
funFactJa: オサキの非難は村の政治でもあった。狐だけでなく隣人を書く。
searchQuery: オサキ 管狐 憑きもの
creativeHooks: A credit score that is a fox.
The moving van includes a sleeve.

name: Mekurabe
summary: Skulls that pile and stare, associated with Taira no Kiyomori's vision of the dead Heike.
summaryJa: 髑髏が積まれてにらみ合う。平清盛が見た平家の死霊のイメージと結びつく。
legends: A sick politician sees a mound of faces on the pillow
Empty eye-sockets still choose a winner
funFact: Gashadokuro is one giant; mekurabe is the crowd still arguing.
funFactJa: 餓者髑髏が一体の巨人なら、目競はまだ議論している群衆。
searchQuery: 目競 平家 髑髏
creativeHooks: A comment section made of bone.
The fever is a quorum.

name: Nuribotoke
summary: A fleshy, dripping mock-buddha that crawls from the butsudan, a parody of household piety.
summaryJa: 仏壇から這い出す、塗ったように濡れた肉の仏。家の信心のパロディ。
legends: The altar figure is glossier than lacquer should be
It bows incorrectly
funFact: Not a real honzon. The joke-horror is that devotion grew a body that wants out.
funFactJa: 本物の本尊ではない。信心が、出たがる体を持ったという冗談の怖さ。
searchQuery: 塗仏 妖怪 石燕
creativeHooks: A smart altar with too much moisture.
The morning offering is returned.

name: Tsurube-bi
summary: A fire that hangs in a tree like a well-bucket, cousin to tsurube-otoshi without the crushing drop.
summaryJa: 木に釣瓶のように吊られる火。釣瓶落としの近縁で、落ちて打つより照らして待つ。
legends: A round flame rises and falls on a rope of nothing
Horses shy under a tree with no lantern
funFact: If you need impact, use tsurube-otoshi; if you need a wrong star in the branches, use this.
funFactJa: 衝撃が要るなら釣瓶落とし。枝の中の間違った星が要るならつるべ火。
searchQuery: つるべ火 釣瓶落とし 妖怪
creativeHooks: A well in the canopy.
The flame keeps shift hours.

name: Aosaginohi
summary: A heron whose feathers or breath glow with a pale fire over the water.
summaryJa: 川面で羽や息が青白く光る鷺。妖怪とも、老いた鷺の生態とも説明される。
legends: A fisherman follows a lantern that takes off
The light smells faintly of river-bird
funFact: Like shiranui, keep both the zoological excuse and the yokai name.
funFactJa: 不知火と同じで、博物の言い訳と妖怪の名を両方残す。
searchQuery: 青鷺火 妖怪
creativeHooks: A wildlife documentary that admits a ghost.
The lure is a bird.

name: Ushirogami
summary: A being that walks just behind you, tugging hair or stealing courage; you turn and it is still behind.
summaryJa: すぐ後ろを歩き、髪を引き、勇気を奪う。振り返っても、また後ろにいる。
legends: Hair lifts on a windless road
The companion you counted is one too many
funFact: Not a jump-scare face. The geometry is the monster: it occupies 'behind'.
funFactJa: 顔の飛び出しではない。怪物は幾何で、『後ろ』という位置を占有する。
searchQuery: 後神 妖怪
creativeHooks: A selfie stick that never finds the extra person.
The courage meter is a neck hair.

name: Katawaguruma
summary: A burning single wheel with a woman's face, a more intimate cousin of wanyudo.
summaryJa: 女の顔を付けた片輪の燃える車。輪入道の、より個人的な近縁。
legends: A one-wheeled fire chases a particular house
The face is someone the town wronged
funFact: Wanyudo is the public monk-wheel; katawaguruma often carries a named woman's anger.
funFactJa: 輪入道が公の僧の輪なら、片輪車はしばしば固有の女の怒りを乗せる。
searchQuery: 片輪車 輪入道 妖怪
creativeHooks: A unicycle of a lawsuit.
The fire knows an address.

name: Yuki-nyudo
summary: A giant monk-shape of snow that looms in blizzards, kin to yuki-onna without the seduction.
summaryJa: 吹雪の中に立つ雪の入道。雪女の近縁だが、色香ではなく質量。
legends: A wall of snow has a face for one gust
Footprints end in a drift the height of a gate
funFact: Use when winter should crush, not kiss.
funFactJa: 冬に口づけではなく、押し潰してほしいときに使う。
searchQuery: 雪入道 雪女 妖怪
creativeHooks: A snowplough that is the snow.
The whiteout has shoulders.

name: Abura-akago
summary: An infant fire-spirit that licks lamp oil, kin to himamushi-nyudo and abura-sumashi.
summaryJa: 灯油を舐める赤子の火。火間虫入道や油すましの近縁。
legends: A lamp dies as a child's laugh passes the eaves
Oil footprints lead to no cradle
funFact: Oil was expensive; the baby is a bill, not a cherub.
funFactJa: 油は高かった。赤子は天使ではなく請求書。
searchQuery: 油赤子 妖怪
creativeHooks: A night-light that invoices you.
The nursery smells of lamp oil.

name: Oshiroi-baba
summary: An old woman who begs for oshiroi, then shows a face already painted for a funeral or a farce.
summaryJa: 白粉を乞う婆。顔はすでに葬礼か道化の化粧である。
legends: A voice at the door asks only for powder
The white face does not come off in rain
funFact: The scare is vanity's leftover, not a jump-scare mask.
funFactJa: 怖さは虚栄の残り物であって、ただの仮面ではない。
searchQuery: 白粉婆 妖怪
creativeHooks: A cosmetics sample that ages the wearer.
The powder is the face.

name: Tenko
summary: The highest rank of kitsune, celestial and long-lived, contrast to yako and zenko.
summaryJa: 狐の最高位。天に通じ、長命。野狐や善狐と対になる。
legends: A white light on the ridge is not a shrine lamp
Nine tails are rumoured, none confirmed
funFact: Tenko is a rank, not a celebrity. Do not auto-cast Tamamo-no-Mae.
funFactJa: 天狐は位階であって固有名詞ではない。すぐ玉藻前にしない。
searchQuery: 天狐 狐 妖怪
creativeHooks: An org chart of foxes.
The summit is a tail.

name: Nozuchi
summary: A legless, mallet-shaped field yokai that rolls and bites, later mixed with tsuchinoko rumours.
summaryJa: 足のない槌型の野の妖怪。転がって噛む。後世のツチノコ噂と混ざる。
legends: A rolling log has a mouth
Dogs refuse a certain grassy bank
funFact: Keep nozuchi older than the tsuchinoko boom; they share a silhouette, not a passport.
funFactJa: 野槌はツチノコブームより古い。シルエットは共有するが戸籍は別。
searchQuery: 野槌 ツチノコ 妖怪
creativeHooks: A rolling pin that hunts.
The field's USB stick is alive.

name: Onmoraki
summary: A bird-like demon born from a corpse's unburied qi, crying with a human voice.
summaryJa: 葬られぬ気から生まれる鳥形の鬼。人の声で鳴く。
legends: A funeral delayed one night too long
A bird calls the deceased's name
funFact: The moral is burial timing, not birdwatching.
funFactJa: 教訓は野鳥観察ではなく、葬りの遅れである。
searchQuery: 陰摩羅鬼 妖怪
creativeHooks: A morgue schedule that grows feathers.
The wake has a choir of one.

name: Waira
summary: A hulking, ox-like mountain brute in Sekien's pictures, more silhouette than story.
summaryJa: 石燕図の、牛めいた巨体の山の獣。物語より絵の印象が先に立つ。
legends: A pass is blocked by something that is all shoulder
Hoofprints too wide for cattle
funFact: Honest about the thin dossier: waira is a drawing that learned to walk.
funFactJa: 資料の薄さを隠さない。わいらは歩き出した絵である。
searchQuery: わいら 妖怪 石燕
creativeHooks: A boss fight with almost no quest text.
The mountain's leftover sketch.

name: Enraenra
summary: Smoke that gathers a face above the hearth or a pipe, then tears apart on a draft.
summaryJa: 炉や煙管の煙が顔になる。風が来るとほどける。
legends: A smoker sees a companion in the cloud
Kitchen smoke refuses to leave the rafters
funFact: The name is smoke plus gauze; it is weather in the house.
funFactJa: 名は煙と羅。家の中の気象である。
searchQuery: 煙羅煙羅 えんらえんら 妖怪
creativeHooks: A vape cloud with opinions.
The kitchen fan is an exorcism.

name: Hitotsume-ren
summary: A one-eyed wind kami/yokai of Ise, later drawn as a whirlwind with a single pupil.
summaryJa: 伊勢の一目の風神・妖怪。後に一つ目の旋風として描かれる。
legends: A gale that watches you
Boats fail when a single light sits in the storm
funFact: Do not confuse with the one-eyed boy; this one is climate.
funFactJa: 一つ目小僧と混ぜない。こちらは気候である。
searchQuery: 一目連 風神 伊勢
creativeHooks: A weather app with one pixel.
The typhoon blinks.

name: Hoko
summary: A dog-like tree spirit from Chinese honzo, said to live in a thousand-year tree's essence.
summaryJa: 本草の、犬に似た木の精。千年の木の精気に棲むという。
legends: A felled camphor bleeds and barks
Woodcutters hear a dog inside the trunk
funFact: Kodama is Japanese tree-soul; hoko is the imported dog in the grain.
funFactJa: 木霊が日本の木の魂なら、彭侯は木目に棲む輸入の犬。
searchQuery: 彭侯 ほうこう 妖怪
creativeHooks: A timber mill that barks.
The grain is a kennel.

name: Kappa-no-kawataro
summary: A western and Kyushu name for kappa; same cucumber politics, local pronunciation.
summaryJa: 西日本・九州で河童を川太郎と呼ぶ。キュウリ外交は同じ、呼び名が土地のもの。
legends: A child by the weir answers to Kawataro, not Kappa
The sara is the same dish
funFact: Treat as a dialect of kappa, not a new species.
funFactJa: 新種にせず、河童の方言として扱う。
searchQuery: 川太郎 河童
creativeHooks: A river census with two columns for one being.
Name tags that say Kawataro.

name: Seto-taisho
summary: A tsukumogami general assembled from cracked Seto ware, leading a tiny ceramic army.
summaryJa: 瀬戸の欠け皿でできた付喪神の大将。小さな陶磁の軍を率いる。
legends: A kitchen crash at midnight with no cat
Shards walk in formation
funFact: The crime is throwing away bowls without thanks.
funFactJa: 罪は、礼もなく皿を捨てたこと。
searchQuery: 瀬戸大将 付喪神
creativeHooks: A dishwasher that drafts an army.
The chipped mug is a colonel.

name: Ouni
summary: A mountain woman covered in hemp-like hair who spins or startles travellers.
summaryJa: 苧のような毛に包まれた山の女。紡ぎ、または旅人を驚かす。
legends: A spinner on a night pass has no lamp and needs none
Hemp fibres move against the wind
funFact: Closer to a work-spirit than to a man-eater.
funFactJa: 人食いより仕事の精に近い。
searchQuery: 苧うに おうに 妖怪
creativeHooks: A spinning wheel on the ridge.
The rope is her hair.

name: Umizatō
summary: A blind biwa-playing sea monk who capsizes boats, cousin to umibozu with a lute.
summaryJa: 琵琶を弾く盲目の海の座頭。船を覆す。海坊主の、楽器付きの近縁。
legends: A biwa from fog with no deck to sit on
Sailors who listen too long list to port
funFact: The music is the hook; the wave is the punchline.
funFactJa: フックは音楽、オチは波。
searchQuery: 海座頭 海坊主 妖怪
creativeHooks: A foghorn that is a lute.
The set list sinks ships.

name: Akashita
summary: A huge red tongue and claws in a black cloud, said to drain ponds or floodgates.
summaryJa: 黒雲から赤い舌と爪。池や水門の水を抜くとも。
legends: A reservoir fails with a lick, not a crack
The cloud has a mouth
funFact: A picture of thirst: the sky drinks the town's water.
funFactJa: 渇きの絵。空が町の水を飲む。
searchQuery: 赤舌 あかした 妖怪
creativeHooks: A drought with a tongue.
The sluice is a palate.

name: Narikama
summary: A kettle that cries or prophesies from the hearth, a tsukumogami of the kitchen fire.
summaryJa: 炉の釜が鳴き、または予言する。台所の火の付喪神。
legends: The kettle sings a name before a guest arrives
A cracked pot refuses to boil until thanked
funFact: Related to narukama oracles; the yokai is the utensil that will not stay mute.
funFactJa: 鳴釜神事の近縁。黙っていられない道具が妖怪になる。
searchQuery: 鳴釜 付喪神
creativeHooks: A smart kettle that gossips.
Boiling is a verdict.

name: Biwa-bokuboku
summary: A neglected biwa that grows a priestly body and walks, playing itself.
summaryJa: 放置された琵琶が僧の体を得て歩き、自ら弾く。
legends: A storehouse lute tunes at midnight
Footsteps in 4/4
funFact: Instruments want ears. This one grew legs to find them.
funFactJa: 楽器は耳を欲する。これは耳を探すために足が生えた。
searchQuery: 琵琶牧々 付喪神
creativeHooks: A forgotten playlist that walks the hall.
The case is a cassock.

name: Koto-furunushi
summary: A neglected koto that becomes an old master and plays ghost pieces at night.
summaryJa: 放置された琴が老いた主になり、夜に誰も作曲していない曲を弾く。
legends: Thirteen strings, fourteen footsteps
A dusty koto has calluses
funFact: Pair with biwa-bokuboku: lute and zither as abandoned staff.
funFactJa: 琵琶牧々と対。琵琶と琴が、捨てられた職員になる。
searchQuery: 琴古主 付喪神
creativeHooks: A koto that books its own recital.
The dust is rosin.

name: Tenaga-ashi
summary: A pair: one with long arms, one with long legs, fishing or hunting as a two-person tool.
summaryJa: 手長と足長のペア。片方は長い手、片方は長い足で漁や狩りをする。
legends: A fish is taken from a cliff no human reach can explain
Two silhouettes share one job
funFact: Write them as a team, not as one mutant.
funFactJa: 一体の突然変異ではなく、二人一組の道具として書く。
searchQuery: 手長足長 妖怪
creativeHooks: A startup with two employees and four-metre limbs.
The net is a handshake.

name: Gataro
summary: A Hokuriku kappa name; same river politics, heavier local accent.
summaryJa: 北陸で河童をガタロと呼ぶ。川の外交は同じ、なまりが土地のもの。
legends: A cucumber left at a weir in Kaga is gone by dawn
Children are told not to swim where Gataro sits
funFact: Same rule as kawataro: a name, not a new monster.
funFactJa: 川太郎と同じ規則。新モンスターではなく呼び名。
searchQuery: ガタロ 河童 北陸
creativeHooks: A river sign in two scripts for one creature.
The dialect has webbed feet.

name: Daitengu
summary: The long-nosed lord of tengu, a mountain hierarch over karasu-tengu and lesser scouts.
summaryJa: 鼻高の天狗の棟梁。烏天狗や小天狗の上に立つ山の法王。
legends: A yamabushi is promoted or broken on a ridge
The fan moves weather, not just air
funFact: Use daitengu when tengu must be a government, not a duel.
funFactJa: 天狗が決闘ではなく政権であるときに使う。
searchQuery: 大天狗 天狗
creativeHooks: A mountain org chart with a nose for a gavel.
The fan is policy.

name: Konoha-tengu
summary: A small tengu of the foothills, messenger or prankster under a daitengu.
summaryJa: 里山の小天狗。大天狗の使い、または悪戯者。
legends: Leaves swirl into a tiny winged shape
A child's kite is returned with a lecture
funFact: The leaf is the scale: this tengu fits in a rumour, not a throne.
funFactJa: 葉が尺度。玉座ではなく噂に収まる天狗。
searchQuery: 木葉天狗 天狗
creativeHooks: An intern with wings.
The memo is a leaf.

name: Yamahime
summary: A mountain princess, beautiful and dangerous, a noble cousin to yamauba rather than a crone.
summaryJa: 山の姫。美しく危うい。山姥の貴種のいとこであって、婆ではない。
legends: A hunter is feasted and forbidden to speak of the hall
Cherry trees bloom on a slope with no village
funFact: Do not age her into yamauba by default; some tellings keep the title.
funFactJa: すぐ山姥に老化させない。称号のまま残る話もある。
searchQuery: 山姫 山姥 妖怪
creativeHooks: A ryokan with no road.
The guest book is a slope.

name: Kawahime
summary: A river princess who invites humans into the current, kin to nure-onna and kawahime tales.
summaryJa: 人を流れへ誘う川の姫。濡女や川姫譚の貴人型。
legends: A lantern on the water is a doorway
Dowries of fish scales
funFact: The palace is the pool. There is no dry audience chamber.
funFactJa: 宮殿は淵である。乾いた謁見の間はない。
searchQuery: 川姫 妖怪
creativeHooks: A wedding at the weir.
The engagement ring is a whirlpool.

name: Danzaburo-tanuki
summary: The chief tanuki of Sado, tied to gold mines and island politics, a feudal tanuki not a prankster only.
summaryJa: 佐渡の化け狸の棟梁。金山と島の政治に絡む。悪戯者というより領主。
legends: Mine lights that are not lamps
A tax of fried tofu that is treated as tribute
funFact: Yashima has Gyobu, Awaji has Shibaemon, Sado has Danzaburo.
funFactJa: 屋島に刑部、淡路に芝右衛門、佐渡に団三郎。
searchQuery: 団三郎狸 佐渡
creativeHooks: A mine tour whose guide is the ore.
The island mascot collects tax.

name: Kincho-tanuki
summary: An Awa tanuki of vendetta tales, loyal and tragic rather than comic.
summaryJa: 阿波の金長狸。仇討ちで知られる義侠の化け狸で、滑稽さより悲劇。
legends: A revenge is carried by something too furry for a samurai
A grave on the ridge is tended by no human
funFact: Write bushido leaking into a tanuki hide.
funFactJa: 武士道が狸の毛皮に漏れた話として書く。
searchQuery: 金長狸 阿波
creativeHooks: A revenge plot with a tail.
The family crest is pawprints.

name: Zenko
summary: A benevolent fox rank that guides humans, contrast to yako field foxes.
summaryJa: 人を導く善い狐の位。野狐と対。
legends: A lost pilgrim is walked to the torii by a white shape
A lie at the shrine is politely undone overnight
funFact: Zenko is HR. Yako is the intern who steals lunch.
funFactJa: 善狐は人事部。野狐は弁当を盗むインターン。
searchQuery: 善狐 稲荷 狐
creativeHooks: A shrine FAQ with paws.
The lost-and-found is a fox.

name: Yakan
summary: A wild fox-name from Buddhist Chinese, harsher than yako, known for cries at dusk.
summaryJa: 漢訳経典由来の野の狐。野狐より棘があり、黄昏の鳴き声で知られる。
legends: A cry that is not a fox and not a human
Translators arguing in the margin
funFact: Keep the bookish origin; yakan is a glossary entry that grew teeth.
funFactJa: 経典語彙を残す。野干は歯が生えた用語集である。
searchQuery: 野干 やかん 狐
creativeHooks: A footnote that hunts.
The dusk is a dictionary.

name: Hitouban
summary: A southern or continental flying-head being; the imported cousin of nukekubi.
summaryJa: 首が飛んで歩く南方・大陸の怪。抜け首の輸入いとこ。
legends: A sleeping body is too still
A head inspects the rafters like a lantern
funFact: Rokurokubi stretches; nukekubi unscrews; hitouban is the passport stamp.
funFactJa: ろくろ首は伸ばし、抜け首は外れ、飛頭蛮はパスポートの印。
searchQuery: 飛頭蛮 抜け首
creativeHooks: A drone that is a relative.
Immigration for necks.

name: Shirohebi
summary: A white snake as kami-messenger or household guardian, often tied to Benzaiten.
summaryJa: 白い蛇を神の使い、家の守りとする。弁才天と結びつくことも多い。
legends: A white snake on the kura beam is not killed
A well is left a saucer of sake
funFact: Do not scale this up to Yamata-no-Orochi; it is a household treaty.
funFactJa: 八岐大蛇に巨大化しない。家との条約である。
searchQuery: 白蛇 弁才天
creativeHooks: A landlord that is a snake.
The insurance policy sheds.

name: Adachigahara
summary: The oni-hag of Adachigahara / Kurozuka who lodges travellers and murders them.
summaryJa: 安達ヶ原・黒塚の鬼婆。旅人を宿し、人を食う。
legends: A kind old woman offers a bed on the moor
A servant is told not to look in the inner room
funFact: Place-name as monster: the moor is the appetite.
funFactJa: 地名が怪物。原が食欲である。
searchQuery: 安達ヶ原 黒塚 鬼婆
creativeHooks: A B&B with a locked pantry.
The noh mask is a map.

name: Numa-gozen
summary: A lady of the marsh who floods or loves with equal excess.
summaryJa: 沼の主の姫。怒りも恋も、水を溢らせて表現する。
legends: A village that skipped a rite wakes to a new shoreline
A bride-price of lotuses
funFact: The disaster is etiquette; hydrology is the language.
funFactJa: 災害は礼儀。水文学は言語。
searchQuery: 沼御前 妖怪
creativeHooks: A flood warning signed with a title.
The marsh has a waiting room.

name: Jinmengyo
summary: A fish with a human face in pond urban legends; looking too long is unlucky.
summaryJa: 人の顔の魚。池の都市伝説で、長く見るな、放せ、と命じられる。
legends: A night carp has eyelids
A photo refuses to focus on the mouth
funFact: Body-horror of the water margin; not mermaid glamour.
funFactJa: 人魚の華やかさではなく、水際のボディホラー。
searchQuery: 人面魚 都市伝説
creativeHooks: A koi show with a caption contest that is a curse.
Do not feed the reflection.

name: Aonyobo
summary: A pale court lady left in a ruined interior, still serving a house that ended.
summaryJa: 廃れた奥に残る青白い女房。終わった家に仕え続ける。
legends: A servant answers in a wing that has no lord
Makeup the colour of old paper
funFact: The horror is HR that outlived the company.
funFactJa: 怖さは、会社より長生きした人事である。
searchQuery: 青女房 妖怪
creativeHooks: An inbox that still CCs a dead domain.
The waiting room is the whole house.

name: Menreiki
summary: A spirit in a noh or ritual mask that chooses, or refuses, its actor.
summaryJa: 能面や仮面に棲む霊気。役者が面を選ぶのではなく、面が役者を選ぶ。
legends: A mask is heavier on some faces
The role continues after the play
funFact: Costume drama as possession: the prop has tenure.
funFactJa: 衣装部が憑きもの。小道具に任期がある。
searchQuery: 面霊気 能面 妖怪
creativeHooks: A dressing room that interviews you.
The understudy is the mask.

name: Hikeshi-baba
summary: An old woman who goes about snuffing people's lights, enemy of lamps and late work.
summaryJa: 人の灯を消してまわる婆。灯火と夜業の敵。
legends: A study lamp dies when a shadow bows in the shoji
The last lantern on the street goes first
funFact: She is the opposite of a night-light. Write her as policy against overtime.
funFactJa: 常夜灯の反対。残業禁止の政策として書く。
searchQuery: 火消婆 妖怪
creativeHooks: A power-saving mode with a grudge.
The curfew is a person.

name: Yosuzume
summary: Sparrows that cry on night passes; meeting them is an omen of fire or theft.
summaryJa: 夜の峠で鳴く雀。出会うと火事や盗難の前兆という。
legends: A flock answers when no village is near
Travellers cover lanterns until the crying stops
funFact: Not a cute mascot sparrow. The cry is a traffic sign.
funFactJa: マスコットの雀ではない。鳴き声は交通標識である。
searchQuery: 夜雀 妖怪 峠
creativeHooks: A navigation ping that is a bird.
The pass has a curfew in chirps.

name: Kazenbo
summary: A monk of Toribeno whose corpse-fire never goes out, a Buddhist picture of leftover karma.
summaryJa: 鳥辺野で燃え続ける僧。業が火になった亡者。
legends: A burning figure walks where funerals used to be
The flame smells of incense and regret
funFact: Keep it local to Toribeno; this is not a generic flaming skeleton.
funFactJa: 鳥辺野に固定する。汎用の燃える骸骨にしない。
searchQuery: 火前坊 鳥辺野 妖怪
creativeHooks: A cemetery lamp that used to be a person.
The fire is a sermon.

name: Narike
summary: A vacant house that coughs, ticks, or weeps at night with no tenants.
summaryJa: 空き家が夜に鳴る。柱や戸が咳をする。
legends: Neighbours hear a family in a boarded house
The sound stops if you knock, then moves to the roof
funFact: The monster is the building's unemployment.
funFactJa: 怪物は、建物の失業である。
searchQuery: 鳴家 空き家 妖怪
creativeHooks: A listing that reviews its own tenants.
The cough is structural.

name: Mokugyo-daruma
summary: A neglected mokugyo that grows a daruma body and walks, still looking for a beat.
summaryJa: 打たれなくなった木魚が達磨になって歩く。拍を探し続ける。
legends: A storehouse thumps in 4/4 with no monk
The round body will not sit still
funFact: Pair with biwa-bokuboku: instruments that refuse retirement.
funFactJa: 琵琶牧々と対。引退を拒否する仏具。
searchQuery: 木魚達磨 付喪神
creativeHooks: A metronome that left the temple.
The beat is a pilgrimage.

name: Berobero
summary: Little more than a standing tongue that licks passers-by, a comic-horror fragment.
summaryJa: 長い舌が道に立って通行人を舐める。短い冗談のような怪異。
legends: A wet stripe on a sleeve with no rain
The tongue bows like a person
funFact: Do not over-explain. The joke is the anatomy.
funFactJa: 説明しすぎない。冗談は解剖である。
searchQuery: べろべろ 妖怪
creativeHooks: A greeting that is a taste test.
The sidewalk has a palate.

name: Kakurezato
summary: A hidden mountain village where time runs slow; leaving once may close the way forever.
summaryJa: 時の遅い山の隠れ里。一度出ると道が消えることもある。
legends: A woodcutter feasts three days and returns to a grave with his name
Smoke without a census
motifs: Rip van Winkle of the hills
funFact: Closer to Tokoyo than to a haunted house. The gift is the problem.
funFactJa: 化け屋敷より常世に近い。贈り物が問題である。
searchQuery: 隠れ里 常世 山
creativeHooks: A calendar that skips decades.
The souvenir is a locked map.

name: Tsujigami
summary: A being of the crossing, god or yokai by hour; meet it at the wrong time and it possesses you.
summaryJa: 辻の神でも妖怪でもある者。時刻を誤ると憑く。
legends: A four-way silence at midnight
Offerings left at the kerb vanish inward
funFact: The place is the person. Do not give it a long biography.
funFactJa: 場所が人格。長い伝記を与えない。
searchQuery: 辻神 妖怪 四つ角
creativeHooks: A traffic light that judges you.
The crossing has office hours.

name: Gotoku-neko
summary: A cat yokai wearing an iron trivet as a crown, between bakeneko and the kitchen fire.
summaryJa: 五徳を頭に乗せた猫の変化。化け猫と炉のあいだ。
legends: The kettle stands on something that purrs
A trivet walks away at dawn
funFact: The hat is the job description: this cat clocks in at the fire.
funFactJa: 帽子が職務記述書。この猫は火に出勤する。
searchQuery: 五徳猫 化け猫 妖怪
creativeHooks: A stove mascot with seniority.
The crown is cookware.

name: Chinzuka-kaio
summary: A king of discarded tools who rules tsukumogami from a rubbish mound.
summaryJa: 捨てられた道具の王。塵の山から付喪神を統べる。
legends: A dump bows
Broken tools assemble into a court
funFact: Seto-taisho is a ceramic colonel; this is the ministry of trash.
funFactJa: 瀬戸大将が陶磁の大佐なら、これはゴミの官庁。
searchQuery: 塵塚怪王 付喪神
creativeHooks: A recycling centre with a throne.
The landfill has protocol.

name: Kejoro
summary: A courtesan yokai whose face is replaced by hanging hair.
